Class Person

java.lang.Object
homework2.Person
Direct Known Subclasses:
Student, Teacher
public abstract class Person extends Object
The Person class represents an individual with a name and date of birth. It is an abstract class, meaning it cannot be instantiated directly and must be extended by other classes. This class provides methods to get and set the name and date of birth of a person, as well as overriding the equals and toString methods to compare and represent a person object.

Example usage:

 Person person = new Person("John Doe", "01/01/2000");
 System.out.println(person.getName()); // Output: John Doe
